changes: New: VECTOR is a MIDI generator for the eight MIDI tracks. Double-tap a MIDI track's key (or double-tap SRC) and choose VECTOR in MIDI NOTE SETUP's list; its twelve controls take the track's ARP page, the second six on FUNC+AMP. It writes real note trigs with NOTE, VEL and LEN locks that the Octatrack's own MIDI sequencer plays, so tempo, track speed, swing, conditions, the channel and every note-off stay stock's. Over USB it needs a Modwerk base with MIDI generators; a card build brings its own.

Faster edits on both kinds of track: a control turn no longer rebuilds the lock index of all 16 tracks (about 3 ms on the unit), the scale's pitches are worked out once a phrase instead of once a step, and the MIDI phrase is written in place. A 64-step rewrite took 0.5 ms on the owner's MKII; the audio frames and the MIDI timing stayed steady while turning. The generated phrases are the same as 0.2.4's.
VECTOR's audio tick reads the Part and track numbers once a tick, and its key layer stays off in MIDI mode.

Tested on the owner's MKII over USB with development bases (21 October 2026): the list, both pages, generation, MIDI output, removal and reinstall. Not tested: a card build on the unit, a physical power cycle, project save and reload, scenes and LFOs on a VECTOR MIDI track, MKI. While VECTOR is not installed, a VECTOR MIDI track's ARP SETUP shows its stored controls as arp notes. The STATIC/FLEX bank problem of #596 is not addressed.

Prevent packed VECTOR settings from making stock Part validation reject the saved bank at startup, which reset machines to STATIC and left PLAY stuck on the first step. Preserve existing S2 version 1/2 settings while retaining stock validation of other data.

Two-instance Part/project save-reload, saved-card fresh load and battery-RAM-only restart pass in the emulator. Physical reboot/audio remain unverified under the owner-approved exception for this exact version. Already reset projects require restoration from a backup.

USB package (14 Oct 2026; distribution only, the module source and version are unchanged): loads over USB as one independent package beside every other module, on a Modwerk base built with site events. What it shares with other machines goes through the base's machine chooser table and take events instead of a machine group, and its authored bytes that coincide with stock are rebuilt from your own OS at install. Emulator and host tests only; no hardware run of this package. The owner waived hardware evidence for this exact version's USB package for the beta.

Documentation-only (19 October 2026): warn that switching a VECTOR track back to STATIC or FLEX with SPAN 8 or higher can leave the bank empty after a save and reboot, read from the source and not yet reproduced, with how to avoid it and keep the saved trigs ([#596](https://github.com/repeat98/modwerk/issues/596)). The firmware is unchanged and the problem is not fixed.
First Modwerk catalog release of VECTOR as a native SRC pattern generator for Flex/Static sample phrases.
Provide backing-pool/sample selection and both native control pages; generated phrases edit the current pattern. Saved-project and hardware behaviour remain unverified.
